Refresh current location/Git metadata while preserving durable configuration and history, then cover reopen after init.

A Store opened before git init and reopened afterwards with identifyProject's fresh descriptor still exposes project.git_common_dir null. Reproduced against the compiled candidate in a disposable Git project. Refresh detected root/git_common_dir durably on open without resetting config/map_version/created_at, and test reopen after init.
